name: intraday-equities-hstar-cv-series
notes: ADR-0058 pass 1: one LightGBM, symbol as category, per-name H. 46 session fields + 20 engineered momentum (no L=120 lags). Sliding 40-fold, 2y train, inner HPO (8 draws). Last val 2025-11-30. Use walkforward, not run. Book collapse deferred. Nothing after 2026-02-28 is in any fold.

universe.notes: lead_start is the training label. One tree, five H's. Short HPO lives on the scan node, not universe.scan.

alpaca.notes: Historical SIP tape. root is the invoking cwd; run from the child root.

session.notes: Research uses regular-session rows; the store still keeps every vendor minute.

momentum_horizons.notes: Few minutes; sharper than the 5m scale already in the 46.
Condenses the old L=120 window into ret/rv/mom.
Few hours, still inside one RTH session.

features.notes: No raw lags. Keep the 46 (5 scales × 5 moments, calendar, SPY residual, industry) plus mom on those scales and ret/rv/mom at 3m/2h/3h/2s/1w (20 extra → 66). ret_lag_0 stays internal for the SPY residual. Action lookback stays 30.

tradable.notes: Score tradable names only. SPY already entered residuals. One tree; each name still walks its own H.

scan.notes: One LightGBM; last column is the symbol category. Short HPO (8 draws) on an inner train holdout — fold val is unread. Then refit pooled train and walk H per name. Base estimator_params are the search prior. GO is a contiguous reject run from h=5; H is the far end.

walkforward.notes: 2y slide. Fold 40 val is 2025-09-29 → 2025-11-30. embargo_days is lead_stop (3 sessions), not H-length. go_frac is the fraction of names with an H this fold — reporting only; the book lock (map vs min vs median) is deferred. Read h_star_<symbol> from fold metrics.

outputs.notes: Empty = ./pipeline_runs under the invoking cwd. Summary is {name}-walkforward-{asof}-{hash8}.

sinks.notes: Local sqlite beside the invoking cwd.

tracking.notes: Excluded from identity — where metrics land is not what the run computes.
